prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adoption redesign (adoption, redesign) was helpful in one confirmed winning test, though a second test showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for most other specific categories (path layout/copy/redesign, home status/redesign, finish notification/redesign, sign-in reordering) as each has only been tested once.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, with rare exceptions where impact was underestimated (such as desktop story copy and path redesign).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +2.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: +3.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: -3.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, notification: +0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +1.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, redesign: -2.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, hint: +0.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -6.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 65.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.0%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Carousel Layout Redesign for Pet Selection: Redesign the pick_friend screen into a full-width visual carousel layout displaying pet personalities and high-resolution companion cards. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 65.9% and a long mean duration of 1017s, suggesting users need a more engaging and direct visual selection interface.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Arrival Checklist Screen: Insert a new desktop arrival checklist screen right before home intro to outline basic controls and screen positioning expectations. (why: Support receives frequent tickets regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets, as well as pets failing to appear.)
2: [home, redesign] Two-Column Waiting Screen for Pet Initialization: Rebuild the waiting screen into a structured two-column layout split between initialization status and desktop tips. (why: The waiting screen (home step) has a very long mean time of 2336s, causing user drops or uncertainty over whether the app stalled.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Stage Layout Path Selection Redesign: Transform the choose_path screen into a stage layout focused on spotlighting instant adoption vs. custom creation options. (why: The choose_path step has a high mean time of 514s, indicating confusion or hesitation when deciding which onboarding track to take.)
4: [sign_in, layout] Centered Minimalist Sign-In Layout: Update the sign_in screen to a simple centered layout focusing entirely on clear, fast authentication options. (why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% with a mean time of 567s and reports of app stalling before or during authentication.)
5: [adoption, incentive] Pet Personality Trait Badges: Add vibrant personality badges to companion options on the pick_friend screen to highlight pet behaviors. (why: Adoption step conversion drops to 65.9%, showing a need for stronger immediate emotional hook during pet selection.)
6: [finish, copy] Desktop Companion Interaction Copy Reframing: Rewrite the home_intro headline and body to explicitly explain how to click, drag, and interact with the pet once live on the desktop. (why: Support received multiple tickets about users being unclear on how to hide, control, or talk to their pet after setup.)
7: [home, wait_info] Estimated Processing Time Banner on Waiting Screen: Add explicit estimated time remaining indicators and real-time generation progress text on the waiting screen. (why: Home step waiting time has a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading users to believe the process stalled.)
8: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Account Saving Micro-Hint: Add micro-copy hint on the adoption certificate screen confirming that pet data is permanently saved to the signed-in account. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after users signed in again.)
